source: The RailsGoat wiki (OWASP/railsgoat.wiki: R5-A1-SQL-Injection-Concatentation, rails_3/A1-SQL-Injection-Interpolation, R5-A1-Command-Injection, R5-A10-Unvalidated-Redirects, Extras:-Constantize, Extras:-Remote-Code-Execution, Extras:-Mass-Assignment-Admin-Role, rails_3/A6-Insecure-Password-Storage, rails_3/A3-Cross-Site-Scripting, rails_4/R4-A8-CSRF, rails_3/A2-Lack-of-HttpOnly-Flag, rails_3/A5-Security-Misconfig-JSON-Escaping), each mapped to its line in OWASP/railsgoat f5951f1 by reading the code the page quotes. Written after the Ruby rules were committed (9229a73) and before any tool ran on RailsGoat. Left out: IDOR, missing access control, credential enumeration, password complexity, insecure compare, logic flaws, supply chain and ReDoS, which no single line carries; the DOM XSS page names a view but not a line; the Send-Method and Metaprogramming pages show examples that are not in the code.
